a1.say: Let's solve Every Balanced Bracket String, using the Backtracking With Counts approach.

a1.cap: Return every string made of n pairs of parentheses that is correctly balanced, in any order.

lines: Return every string made of n pairs of parentheses that is correctly balanced, in any order.

a1.say: For example, with n equals 3, the answer is "(())", "()", "()", "()", "".

a1.cap: Build the string left to right. You may add ( while fewer than n are open, and ) only while it closes an unmatched (. Those two rules generate exactly the balanced strings.
